name: dev-doctor
description: Read-only environment checks on session start (bash on PATH, .NET SDK/runtime, ports, git locks, worktrees, Docker, AUTH_SECRET, Node, Worker) with a status line, toast and pane

intervalMinutes.title: Re-run every N minutes (0 = off)
intervalMinutes.description: Minutes between background re-runs; 0 turns the timer off.

nodeMajor.title: Expected Node major when the repo pins none
nodeMajor.description: Node major to expect when the repo has no .nvmrc, .node-version or engines.node.

workerProcess.title: Worker process name
workerProcess.description: Image name of the background worker, with or without .exe.

appHostProcess.title: AppHost process name (blank = AppHost folder name)
appHostProcess.description: Image name of the AppHost; blank uses the AppHost folder name.

dockerExitedHours.title: Exited containers older than N hours fail
dockerExitedHours.description: Exited containers older than this many hours fail the Docker check.

lockStaleSeconds.title: A git lock older than this fails
lockStaleSeconds.description: A git lock file older than this many seconds fails; younger ones warn.

disabledChecks.title: Check ids to skip, comma list
disabledChecks.description: Check ids to skip, comma separated (bash, dotnet-sdk, dotnet-runtime, ports, git-locks, git-worktrees, docker, auth-secret, node, worker).

rerunAfterTools.title: Re-run volatile checks after port/process commands
rerunAfterTools.description: Re-run the volatile checks a few seconds after a Bash or PowerShell command that starts or stops apps, containers or worktrees.

composeSection.title: Tell the model the current FAILs
composeSection.description: Add a short system-prompt section naming the current FAILs and running apps that hold ports.
